answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like an ember that only burns while fuel is committed: each fake identity costs real funds, so a Sybil swarm becomes expensive fast. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest, while detected fakes lose it; saffron-grade reputation grows only from sustained good behavior, not from volume. The result is an oasis where one verified identity is worth more than a thousand cheap copies, because attacking the market costs more than it can ever return.
